ACT XXIV OF 2020
ACT XXIV OF 2020
SINDH FINANCE (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2020
An Act to amend the Sindh Finance
Act, 2010
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
5th September, 2020]
No.
PAS/LEGIS-B-21/2020, dated 5.9.2020.---The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Bill, 2020 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 24th August, 2020 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 03rd September, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Finance Act, 2010, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Finance (Amendment) Act, 2020.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Omission of section 4 of Sindh Act No.XIII of 2010
